CustomField.label: Related Record Id
CustomField.description: Generic pointer for objects that have no dedicated lookup here — the standard Partner object, PRM records like PartnerFundClaim, or any custom object. Set it to the record id and the ring resolves from that object's page with no schema change. Account__c and Contact__c take precedence when both are set.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The 15 or 18 character id of the record this tier belongs to. Only needed for objects without their own lookup field above.
